items.item: Each category in the tree shows a product count, the page states whether counts include subcategories, and in the sample data every parent's total equals its own products plus the totals of its children
items.evidence: Each tree row renders `nfCount.format(totalCount(node))` (page.html:609-612). The detail panel labels the two figures explicitly as 'Products (own)' (#detail-own-count) and 'Products (incl. subcategories)' (#detail-total-count, line 147), clarifying that the tree figure is the inclusive total. `totalCount()` (line 434-440) recursively sums `node.ownCount` plus every descendant's `totalCount`, so parent = own + children totals by construction (e.g. Electronics 1,112 = 12 own + 34+8+19+76 branch sums visible in first.png).

items.item: The tree exposes its structure to screen readers (role="tree" and "treeitem", or nested lists) with aria-expanded on parent nodes and the selected node marked, and nodes can be expanded, collapsed and selected from the keyboard
items.evidence: `<ul id="tree" role="tree">` (line 85) with rows `role="treeitem"` plus `aria-level`/`aria-setsize`/`aria-posinset` (lines 570-577); `aria-expanded` is set for nodes with children (line 576) and `aria-selected` reflects the active node (line 575). Keydown handler on `#tree` implements ArrowUp/Down (move focus), ArrowRight/Left (expand/collapse or move to parent), Enter/Space (select), Home/End, and typeahead (lines 666-732).

items.item: Searching by name keeps the ancestors of each matching category visible and expanded so its place in the hierarchy is clear, and a search with no matches says so
items.evidence: `matchSet()` builds `withAncestors` by walking each match's `parentId` chain (lines 498-509), and `visibleRows()`/`renderTree()` force those ancestors to render expanded (line 563: `isExpanded = searchQuery.trim() ? true : ...`). No-match case shows `#tree-no-results` with text 'No category matches "<query>"' and a Clear search button (lines 86-89, 550-554).

items.item: The detail panel shows the selected category's full path (such as "Home › Kitchen › Cookware"), name, URL slug, parent, visibility status, product count with a link to those products, and the last modified date and user
items.evidence: Breadcrumb built from `pathTo(node)` into `#detail-path` (lines 779-808), `#detail-name` and `#detail-slug` (810-812), `#detail-parent` (824), `#detail-visible` Yes/No plus the status badge (814-817, 825), `#detail-view-all-products` link reading 'View all N' with href `#products?category=...` (882-883), and `#detail-audit` text 'Last changed by <user> on <date>' (885-886).

items.item: Hidden or inactive categories are marked in the tree with a text label or icon (such as "Hidden"), not only by greying out
items.evidence: Rows for any node with `status !== "active"` append a text badge with the status label ('Inactive' or 'Archived') via `statusTone()` (lines 457-461, 601-607); visible in first.png as 'Seasonal: swimwear — Archived' and 'Discontinued lines — Archived'.

items.item: Deleting a category that still has products or subcategories is blocked or requires choosing where to move them, and the confirmation names the category and the counts affected
items.evidence: `openDeleteConfirm()` (lines 948-969): if `ownCount > 0 || childCount > 0` the Delete button is hidden and the dialog text reads 'Cannot delete "<name>": it has N products assigned directly and M subcategories. Reassign its products and subcategories first.', naming the category and both counts.

items.item: A category can be given a new parent without drag-and-drop (a parent picker or "Move to…" action), and the picker excludes the category itself and its own descendants
items.evidence: The 'Move to…' menu item exists (`#action-move`, line 131) but its handler only calls `showToast("Move picker is not wired up in this preview.")` (line 937) — no picker UI is implemented, so there is no way to verify (or satisfy) exclusion of the category and its descendants.

items.item: Selecting another category while the detail form has unsaved edits asks to save or discard first
items.evidence: There is no editable form state at all — `#btn-edit` only shows a toast 'Opening the edit form is not wired up in this preview.' (line 936), and `selectNode()` (lines 649-655) switches selection unconditionally with no dirty-check or confirmation.

items.item: With nothing selected the detail panel shows a prompt instead of blank fields, a catalogue with no categories offers to create the first one, and the tree has loading and load-error-with-retry states
items.evidence: `#detail-empty` correctly shows 'Select a category to see its details' with an Add category button when `selectedId` is unset (lines 97-104, 770-776), but that is the only part implemented. `DATA` is a hardcoded non-empty array with no code path for an empty catalogue, and there is no loading indicator or error/retry UI anywhere in the markup or script (confirmed via search — no 'loading', 'retry', or 'error' state exists).

notes: This is a static mock-data prototype: several menu actions (Add category, Edit, Move to…) are stubbed to show a toast reading 'not wired up in this preview' rather than opening real UI, which is why the move-picker and unsaved-edit-guard checklist items fail — the underlying affordances (button/menu entry) exist but have no implementation behind them. No template-tell patterns (gradients, glass, emoji icons, kpi tiles, rainbow status, promo cards, etc.) were observed; the UI is a plain, restrained Tailwind admin layout.
